title: Slide Cloud 0.1.0 - Windows alpha
notes: First Windows alpha: original orange squircle presentation logo, local slide library and autosave, editable slide templates, text, shapes and images, slide organization, speaker notes, slideshow, native backups and basic PPTX exchange. Joins Doc Cloud and Sheet Cloud in BlueCloud Launcher. Office compatibility is limited; animations, transitions, embedded media and hosted collaboration are not included.
